## Cross-cutting invariants

### `U6-INV-01` — One integrated delivery line

Deployment and collaboration are two mandatory scopes inside the same PR1-to-PR6 dependency line. They are not parallel roadmaps, optional add-ons, or substitutes for one another.

### `U6-INV-02` — No half-complete PR

A PR is incomplete if any delivery-scope item, collaboration-scope item, or required evidence item is missing. Completion language such as done, merged, released, or deployed must name the evidence class it actually proves.

### `U6-INV-03` — Three data planes stay separate

Coordination holds short-lived presence, leases, progress, findings, blockers, conflicts, and receipts; Project Working Set is a bounded rebuildable projection for the active task or PR; Canonical Memory holds governed stable facts, decisions, principles, and lessons. No plane silently becomes another plane's authority.

### `U6-INV-04` — Server single-writer authority

The server is the sole coordination, canonical SQLite, governance, accepted-result validation, receipt-persistence, and LanceDB-promotion decision authority. Edge and compute claims, project IDs, manifests, capabilities, and model identity are validation inputs, never authority grants.

### `U6-INV-05` — Strict project and session scope

Every Agent session, work item, lease, event, cursor, receipt, retrieval, promotion candidate, and lifecycle action must be bound to canonical project_id and coordination_session_id. Cross-project or ambiguous legacy state fails closed or enters non-claimable quarantine.

### `U6-INV-06` — Typed bounded collaboration, not prompt sharing

Agents exchange typed, audience-filtered summaries, references, evidence digests, state transitions, and receipts. Raw prompts, private or hidden reasoning, credentials, lease tokens, provider secrets, full result bodies, and unrestricted peer history never enter collaboration projections or memory proposals.

### `U6-INV-07` — Cursor pull is the correctness path

Incremental awareness uses project/session/audience-bound cursor pull with replay, monotonic from/to positions, gap detection, and bounded pages. SSE or other push transport may improve the frontend experience but is never the only correctness channel.

### `U6-INV-08` — Evidence-governed memory promotion

Peer progress, heartbeats, assumptions, findings, agreement, and semantic capture never become canonical memory. Only a server-validated accepted result with stable evidence, independent review authority, project scope, and resolved conflict state may become a pending proposal; adoption remains a separate governed action.

### `U6-INV-09` — Shared lease primitives, separate authority planes

Developer-Agent work and compute inference jobs reuse one semantic contract for lease, fence, heartbeat, result receipt, retry, reconcile, idempotency, and project scope. Their record types, persistence tables, operation policies, capabilities, and authorization adapters remain distinct and cannot be cast into one another.

### `U6-INV-10` — Least privilege and independent acceptance

Agent identity is bound by the server to a versioned role/tool/capability policy. A delegated Agent cannot grant itself reviewer or coordinator visibility, accept its own finding, mutate canonical memory, merge a PR, deploy, promote a generation, start Maintenance, or modify another Agent's events.

### `U6-INV-11` — Immutable lineage and receipts

Accepted artifacts, awareness projections, deployment plans, migrations, releases, and promotions bind immutable source identities, revisions, digests, cursors, fences, and typed receipts. A completed state plus an artifact reference is not, by itself, an accepted result.

### `U6-INV-12` — Source evidence is not runtime evidence

A contract, fake adapter, source recipe, unit test, image descriptor, or documentation receipt proves only its stated layer. It cannot prove a listener, persistent runtime, migration, restart, promotion, Maintenance transition, RC publication, stable release, or production acceptance without matching external receipts.

### `U6-INV-13` — Bilingual generated parity

English and Chinese union-contract views are generated from the same JSON bytes and carry the same SHA-256. Every PR must also keep affected English/Chinese docs, architecture diagrams, badges, links, and resource or pricing tables synchronized.

### `U6-INV-14` — UTC semantics without host timezone mutation

The server backend is the sole canonical clock authority. Every persisted or authoritative wire timestamp is server-issued, timezone-aware UTC in canonical Z form. Edge, client, and compute timestamps are diagnostic source observations only and MUST NOT influence ordering, lease expiry, fencing, idempotency, receipts, promotion, or cursor progression. Frontends may localize timestamps for display but MUST NOT write localized values back as authority. Installation must not mutate Linux, macOS, Windows, WSL2, edge, server, or compute host timezone settings.

### `U6-INV-15` — Workflow Composer remains subordinate to hard gates

Workflow Composer is included in PR6 as shadow-only behavior. It may propose an atomic-skill plan and a new frozen plan revision, but a deterministic compiler must restore non-removable safety, review, evidence, migration, release, and authorization gates. It cannot mutate an executing revision, self-attest a user-only stage, waive any item in this contract, or replace the fixed execution route.

### `U6-INV-16` — Independent Standards, Spec, and DeepSec review

Every PR requires three distinct review channels bound to the same immutable source revision, diff digest, requirement set, and contract revision: Standards conformance, Spec conformance, and DeepSec Shield/code-smell review. Missing, stale, self-issued, cross-revision, or mismatched receipts block completion.

### `U6-INV-17` — AcceptanceReceipt is an authenticated decision

An AcceptanceReceipt is a server-authenticated, project/session-scoped decision over one WorkReceipt and ResultReceipt, with independent submitter/reviewer sessions, immutable work/result/evidence digests, policy revision, conflict decision, and UTC issuance time. A result status, artifact reference, reviewer string, or self-attestation cannot substitute for it.

## PR contracts

## PR1 — Routing core and collaboration foundation

**Objective:** Create the governed inference-routing seam and the immutable, project-scoped collaboration contracts that every later PR can safely build on.

- **Depends on:** —
- **Required gates:** `U6-GATE-SOURCE-01`, `U6-GATE-REVISION-01`, `U6-GATE-DOCUMENT-01`, `U6-GATE-ASSET-01`, `U6-GATE-REVIEW-01`, `U6-GATE-DEEPSEC-01`, `U6-GATE-EVIDENCE-01`

### Delivery scope

- **`PR1-D01`** — Introduce one typed routing interface for query embedding, index/outbox embedding, and rerank, with local-node, cloud, and deterministic degradation adapters behind it.
- **`PR1-D02`** — Enforce exact embedding identity compatibility, explicit profile selection on identity disagreement, bounded health/circuit recovery, and separation of core MCP readiness from optional structured-inference readiness.
- **`PR1-D03`** — Provide durable queue/reconcile semantics for unavailable derived work without creating another canonical writer or treating LanceDB as recovery authority.
- **`PR1-D04`** — Migrate every existing task enqueue, dedupe, claim, heartbeat, complete, verify/review, inbox, release/abandon, and recovery path plus schema/index/trigger constraints to mandatory project_id; ambiguous legacy rows are quarantined and non-claimable.

### Collaboration scope

- **`PR1-C01`** — Define secret-free typed contracts for AgentIdentity, AgentSession, ProjectScope, CoordinationSession, WorkItem, WorkLease, CollaborationEvent, EventCursor/EventPage, WorkReceipt, ResultReceipt, ReviewReceipt, and AcceptanceReceipt.
- **`PR1-C02`** — Add a project/session-scoped append-only CollaborationEventLog foundation with idempotent event identity, causal-parent checks, expiry, audience filtering, bounded cursor reads, corruption detection, and explicit SQLite injection; do not wire production listeners yet.
- **`PR1-C03`** — Define the ProjectWorkBoard boundary over the hardened task lifecycle so handlers do not become the long-term SQL authority; persistence adapters and the mutable registry/work-board lifecycle remain PR5 work.
- **`PR1-C04`** — Bind Agent identity/session values to a versioned least-privilege role, tool, and capability policy contract. Caller-provided role or capability strings do not grant authority; authenticated runtime binding is completed in PR5.
- **`PR1-C05`** — Encode the Coordination, Project Working Set, and Canonical Memory separation, including the rule that peer progress and unverified findings are never automatically promotion-eligible.
- **`PR1-C06`** — Define AcceptanceReceipt as a server-authenticated immutable decision binding acceptance_receipt_id, project_id, coordination_session_id, work_item_id, WorkReceipt, ResultReceipt, submitter_agent_session_id, independent reviewer_agent_session_id, review_policy_revision, source_revision, work/result/evidence digests, decision, conflict_state, and issued_at_utc. Self-acceptance, caller-supplied reviewer identity, unresolved conflict, stale policy, cross-scope receipt, or digest mismatch fails closed.

### Required evidence

- **`PR1-E01`** — Focused query/index/rerank route tests plus exact-identity, profile-selection, degradation, circuit-recovery, and optional-provider-health evidence.
- **`PR1-E02`** — Contract validation and secret/private-reasoning rejection matrix covering every required collaboration value, WorkItem/WorkLease lifecycle edge, and minimum-policy binding.
- **`PR1-E03`** — Event-log append/idempotency/causal-scope/audience/expiry/cursor/corruption tests and a cross-project negative matrix for every hardened task operation and migration/recovery transaction.
- **`PR1-E04`** — Bilingual documentation and generated union-contract drift gate, with explicit upgrade, degradation, rollback, quarantine, and no-production-activation statements.
- **`PR1-E05`** — AcceptanceReceipt conformance and negative evidence covering authenticated server issuance, independent reviewer sessions, WorkReceipt/ResultReceipt/digest binding, policy revision, conflict decision, replay/idempotency, self-acceptance, stale policy, cross-project/session scope, and tampered or mismatched evidence.
- **`PR1-E06`** — Independent Standards, Spec, and DeepSec Shield/code-smell review receipts bound to the same immutable source revision, diff digest, requirement set, and union-contract revision, with DeepSec least-privilege and non-canonical-finding proof.

### Completion rule

- `operator`: `all`
- `required_groups`: `delivery_scope`, `collaboration_scope`, `required_evidence`
- `prohibits_partial_completion`: `true`
- PR1 is complete only when the routing/task delivery seam and the full immutable collaboration foundation are both implemented and evidenced. Task project isolation or collaboration value classes alone are insufficient.

## PR2 — Endpoint contracts and shared lease semantics

**Objective:** Define closed three-endpoint authority and make compute jobs and Agent work conform to the same lease semantics without merging their authority planes.

- **Depends on:** `PR1`
- **Required gates:** `U6-GATE-SOURCE-01`, `U6-GATE-REVISION-01`, `U6-GATE-DOCUMENT-01`, `U6-GATE-ASSET-01`, `U6-GATE-REVIEW-01`, `U6-GATE-DEEPSEC-01`, `U6-GATE-EVIDENCE-01`

### Delivery scope

- **`PR2-D01`** — Define versioned pp-local-edge, pp-server-backend, and pp-compute-node contracts through a closed EndpointAuthority resolve/assess/verify_completion interface.
- **`PR2-D02`** — Compile server-owned role/action authority profiles: edge submits intent and reads bounded projections; server owns canonical state, inference-job scheduling and validation, and collaboration/governance decisions; compute may execute bounded embedding, rerank, and structured-JSON work and return derived evidence only.
- **`PR2-D03`** — Define manifest/hello/capability/result identities, exact model compatibility, resource floors, schema versions, idempotency, timeout, cancellation, terminal reasons, resource reports, and golden-probe evidence without activating runtime persistence.

### Collaboration scope

- **`PR2-C01`** — Create one common semantic contract for Lease, Fence, Heartbeat, ResultReceipt, RetryDecision, ReconcileDecision, idempotency, expiry, and ProjectScope, with conformance adapters for both Agent work and compute jobs.
- **`PR2-C02`** — Keep Agent WorkItem/WorkLease records, compute job/lease records, tables, operation policies, capabilities, result bodies, and authorization adapters distinct; no matching project_id or structural cast crosses the boundary.
- **`PR2-C03`** — Use server-issued current fences and server-owned retry/reconcile decisions. Stale, expired, mismatched, replayed, or cross-plane completions fail closed with stable reason codes.
- **`PR2-C04`** — Deny compute all Task Queue, AgentRegistry, ProjectWorkBoard, collaboration-event-writer, awareness, memory/knowledge-promotion, merge, deployment, Maintenance, canonical SQLite, and LanceDB-promotion authority.

### Required evidence

- **`PR2-E01`** — Endpoint schema round-trip, secret rejection, closed authority matrix, exact identity, protocol compatibility, resource-floor, and role denial tests.
- **`PR2-E02`** — One shared lease-semantics conformance suite executed against both the Agent-work adapter and compute-job adapter, covering fence, heartbeat, receipt, retry, reconcile, expiry, idempotency, and project scope.
- **`PR2-E03`** — Negative proofs that a compute completion cannot complete Agent work, an Agent receipt cannot satisfy a compute job, and caller claims cannot grant either authority.
- **`PR2-E04`** — Source-only upgrade/degradation/rollback and bilingual documentation evidence that makes no listener, persistence, migration, deployment, or production claim.
- **`PR2-E05`** — Independent Standards, Spec, and DeepSec Shield/code-smell review receipts bound to the same immutable source revision, diff digest, requirement set, and union-contract revision, with DeepSec least-privilege and non-canonical-finding proof.

### Completion rule

- `operator`: `all`
- `required_groups`: `delivery_scope`, `collaboration_scope`, `required_evidence`
- `prohibits_partial_completion`: `true`
- PR2 is complete only when endpoint authority and the common Agent/compute lease semantics both pass their conformance and isolation proofs. Compute-only lease classes are not sufficient.

## PR3 — Container artifacts and Passive Memory collaboration events

**Objective:** Prove role-specific artifact boundaries and connect Passive Memory Hooks to typed collaboration events without promoting transient Agent activity into memory.

- **Depends on:** `PR2`
- **Required gates:** `U6-GATE-SOURCE-01`, `U6-GATE-REVISION-01`, `U6-GATE-DOCUMENT-01`, `U6-GATE-ASSET-01`, `U6-GATE-REVIEW-01`, `U6-GATE-DEEPSEC-01`, `U6-GATE-EVIDENCE-01`

### Delivery scope

- **`PR3-D01`** — Provide a secret-free ContainerArtifactCompiler prepare/materialize seam and a role × platform × variant matrix for edge, server, compute CPU, and compute CUDA.
- **`PR3-D02`** — Require immutable OCI, SBOM, provenance, application-inventory, role-label, non-root, read-only-rootfs, listener, mount, and layer-exclusion evidence; model weights, databases, secrets, runtime state, logs, and build caches stay out of layers.
- **`PR3-D03`** — Package collaboration writer/runtime modules only in the server artifact; edge receives only bounded projection/submission contracts and compute physically contains no collaboration package or configuration surface.
- **`PR3-D04`** — Keep local runtime activation, listener binding, tunnel creation, registry push, migration, promotion, Maintenance, MCP restart, and production mutation out of PR3; protected no-push build verification is evidence only.

### Collaboration scope

- **`PR3-C01`** — On Stop, publish a bounded project/session-scoped work.progressed or work.submitted event; publish accepted-result events only when a server-authenticated independent acceptance receipt already exists.
- **`PR3-C02`** — Keep semantic capture unchanged as a pending-proposal producer. Ordinary progress, peer events, assumptions, findings, and submitted-but-unaccepted work are never memory proposals or canonical memory.
- **`PR3-C03`** — Route only accepted work with typed receipt, stable evidence, project scope, and conflict state into the CollaborationMemoryPromoter input contract; the output may be only a pending proposal and adoption remains separate.
- **`PR3-C04`** — Hook event payloads contain typed summaries, artifact/evidence references, and causal links only; raw prompt, hidden reasoning, credentials, result bodies, lease tokens, and provider secrets are rejected.

### Required evidence

- **`PR3-E01`** — Artifact policy, final-rootfs inventory, SBOM/provenance, role-label, mount/layer, and import-denial checks proving server-only collaboration and complete compute exclusion.
- **`PR3-E02`** — Stop Hook tests for progress/submission/accepted-event selection, scope binding, idempotency, fail-open retry behavior, bounded payloads, and secret/private-reasoning rejection.
- **`PR3-E03`** — Promotion negative matrix proving peer progress, agreement, completed-plus-artifact, self-acceptance, assumptions, findings, and semantic capture cannot bypass an authenticated acceptance receipt or create canonical memory.
- **`PR3-E04`** — Explicit no-runtime/no-production activation assertion and bilingual artifact/Hook boundary documentation.
- **`PR3-E05`** — Independent Standards, Spec, and DeepSec Shield/code-smell review receipts bound to the same immutable source revision, diff digest, requirement set, and union-contract revision, with DeepSec least-privilege and non-canonical-finding proof.

### Completion rule

- `operator`: `all`
- `required_groups`: `delivery_scope`, `collaboration_scope`, `required_evidence`
- `prohibits_partial_completion`: `true`
- PR3 is complete only when both artifact isolation and Passive Memory collaboration-event/promotion boundaries are implemented and tested. Server-only packaging by itself does not complete PR3.

## PR4 — Deployment Center and collaboration retrieval projection

**Objective:** Deliver a read-only deployment-planning surface and an authenticated, bounded collaboration projection that context_supply composes beside, never inside, canonical memory retrieval.

- **Depends on:** `PR3`
- **Required gates:** `U6-GATE-SOURCE-01`, `U6-GATE-REVISION-01`, `U6-GATE-DOCUMENT-01`, `U6-GATE-ASSET-01`, `U6-GATE-REVIEW-01`, `U6-GATE-DEEPSEC-01`, `U6-GATE-EVIDENCE-01`

### Delivery scope

- **`PR4-D01`** — Provide a host-only DeploymentCenter with only inspect and preview plus a closed ppctl dispatcher; apply, shell, Docker, SSH, arbitrary paths/commands, credential transfer, node contact, services, database mutation, promotion, and receipt persistence remain unavailable.
- **`PR4-D02`** — Use bounded JSON input, secret-free manifest candidates, redacted fresh projections, macOS/Linux/Windows-WSL2 resource inspection, profile recommendation/override, model identity comparison, safe-space refusal, and inspection-only update classes.
- **`PR4-D03`** — Keep pp-local-edge a non-authoritative static browser entry and keep the existing backend MCP endpoint authoritative; every status or plan claim requires a fresh host/server projection.

### Collaboration scope

- **`PR4-C01`** — Implement ProjectWorkingSet as a bounded, rebuildable, non-authoritative projection and AgentAwarenessProjection as a role/audience-specific delta view; neither grants lease, execution, review, or memory authority.
- **`PR4-C02`** — Retrieve project memory and peer collaboration events through separate ranking paths. context_supply composes an independent collaboration field after memory retrieval; peer relevance never changes canonical-memory scores or overrides user instructions.
- **`PR4-C03`** — Provide role-aware relevance using work dependency, same module/symbol/artifact/decision, causal distance, freshness, and severity; open conflict and blocker events rank ahead of ordinary progress.
- **`PR4-C04`** — Bind every collaboration delta to a server-authenticated source tuple: source_kind=collaboration-event-log, source_authority=server, project_id, coordination_session_id, audience, AgentSession policy_revision, event_schema_revision, event_log_revision, cursor_from, cursor_to, source_page_digest, projection_factory_revision, and generated_at_utc. Reject role or audience self-assertion, source substitution, cursor regression/gaps, forged pages or digests, stale policy/factory revision, and arbitrary caller-constructed projections.
- **`PR4-C05`** — Accepted artifacts require the exact server-authenticated independent AcceptanceReceipt contract from PR1-C06, including acceptance_receipt_id and receipt digest in the source tuple. completed plus artifact_refs, a reviewer string, or an unbound ResultReceipt is insufficient. Objectives, capabilities, event payloads, prompts, private reasoning, credentials, and result bodies are redacted at the server-owned projection factory.

### Required evidence

- **`PR4-E01`** — DeploymentCenter two-operation allowlist, bounded streaming input, V2-only candidate, redaction, profile/resource/model comparison, safe-space refusal, and no-mutation tests.
- **`PR4-E02`** — Working-set and awareness boundary tests for project/session isolation and the exact server-authenticated source tuple: source kind/authority, authenticated role and audience, policy/event-schema/event-log/projection-factory revisions, source page digest, cursor_from/to resume and gap behavior, generated_at_utc, bounded source/page/output sizes, AcceptanceReceipt lineage when present, and redaction.
- **`PR4-E03`** — context_supply integration proof that memory and collaboration are retrieved/ranked separately then composed, with conflict/blocker priority and no canonical-memory effect.
- **`PR4-E04`** — Negative tests for forged reviewer/coordinator role or audience, forged or self-issued AcceptanceReceipt, source-kind/authority/revision/digest substitution, caller-built projections, cursor skipping/replay ambiguity, raw-prompt/private-reasoning leakage, stale policy or projection-factory revision, and peer override of user or canonical context.
- **`PR4-E05`** — Independent Standards, Spec, and DeepSec Shield/code-smell review receipts bound to the same immutable source revision, diff digest, requirement set, and union-contract revision, with DeepSec least-privilege and non-canonical-finding proof.

### Completion rule

- `operator`: `all`
- `required_groups`: `delivery_scope`, `collaboration_scope`, `required_evidence`
- `prohibits_partial_completion`: `true`
- PR4 is complete only when the read-only Deployment Center and authenticated collaboration retrieval/context_supply composition both work. Pure projection value classes without a trusted feed and retrieval consumer are insufficient.

## PR5 — Migration operations and collaboration runtime

**Objective:** Activate the persistent server-owned runtime for three-endpoint migration and the complete Agent registry, work-board, Hook, MCP, Maintenance, promotion, and frontend lifecycle with reversible recovery. All embedding, reranking, and structured-JSON inference is routed through pp-compute-node; pp-server-backend remains a canonical read/write, scheduling, lease, and reconciliation authority.

- **Depends on:** `PR4`
- **Required gates:** `U6-GATE-SOURCE-01`, `U6-GATE-REVISION-01`, `U6-GATE-DOCUMENT-01`, `U6-GATE-ASSET-01`, `U6-GATE-REVIEW-01`, `U6-GATE-DEEPSEC-01`, `U6-GATE-EVIDENCE-01`

### Delivery scope

- **`PR5-D01`** — Provide a server-owned typed MigrationOperation plan/grant/lease/fence/phase/receipt orchestrator with a backup-gated durable journal, drift rejection, one-shot grants, stable failures, and restart recovery; browser/ppctl remain read-only.
- **`PR5-D02`** — Perform authorized preflight, immutable image verification, online backup and integrity rehearsal, single-writer cutover, endpoint/tunnel/capability/model checks, SQLite migration, shadow LanceDB rebuild and atomic promotion, Maintenance transition, rollback, and secret-free receipt persistence through typed adapters.
- **`PR5-D03`** — Keep canonical SQLite mounted only by pp-server-backend/pp-core, keep LanceDB rebuildable derived state, enable Maintenance by default after successful cutover, retain production backups for at most five days, and clear temporary cache daily.
- **`PR5-D04`** — Enforce endpoint-role separation: pp-server-backend MUST NOT construct or invoke hosted/local/raw embedding, reranking, or structured-JSON providers. Only pp-compute-node may hold provider adapters, model runtimes, cloud URLs, and provider credentials; server requests use the authenticated private compute-node transport or return a stable defer/original-order outcome.
- **`PR5-D05`** — Support control-plane inference_mode values local, cloud, and hybrid. Routing MUST read the active control revision on each request so mode changes take effect without MCP restart; hybrid selects only registered compute nodes whose advertised provider class and capability identity satisfy the requested operation.
- **`PR5-D06`** — Project compute credentials are compute-only projections: dashboard writes are write-only, never echoed in responses or receipts, and become active only after an atomic compute profile activation plus identity revalidation receipt matching model, revision, dimension, normalization, and structured-JSON identity fields.
- **`PR5-D07`** — Treat structured JSON as a first-class compute-node capability with bounded prompt, payload, output, timeout, and UTF-8 limits; token requests are provider-adaptive and have no arbitrary 8192-token local ceiling. Enforce strict model/revision identity checks, secret-free diagnostics, and durable result receipts; server-side context assembly may request this capability but cannot execute it.
- **`PR5-D08`** — When no healthy compute node with the exact required identity is available, fail closed with operation-specific stable degradation: embedding and structured JSON defer for retry/reconcile, while rerank returns original-order without a server-side provider fallback.

### Collaboration scope

- **`PR5-C01`** — Persist AgentRegistry and ProjectWorkBoard behind server single-writer authority, including join/active/idle/stale/closed Agent lifecycle and proposed/ready/leased/in_progress/submitted/reviewing/accepted/rework/expired work lifecycle.
- **`PR5-C02`** — Extend session-init to register an authenticated Agent session and return bound policy, working-set summary, assigned work, peer delta, and cursor; heartbeat/tool calls reconcile presence, leases, and incremental feed state.
- **`PR5-C03`** — UserPromptSubmit loads bounded project memory and collaboration delta separately; Stop publishes typed progress/result events plus stable user-fact pending proposals; SessionEnd publishes agent.closed, releases leases, advances/records cursor state, and cleans local turn state.
- **`PR5-C04`** — sp-stage emits typed stage started/completed/blocked/receipt events, while step-closure emits a collaboration result receipt separately from an optional memory proposal.
- **`PR5-C05`** — Maintenance expires stale presence, retained events, and abandoned leases; reconciles expired work to the correct state; preserves append-only audit evidence; and never adopts a proposal or deletes canonical memory as cleanup.
- **`PR5-C06`** — Activate authenticated server feed and collaboration awareness in shadow before injection, then expose Agent topology, project work board, and event timeline in the frontend with project/session/role filtering and cursor-based refresh.
- **`PR5-C07`** — Implement CollaborationMemoryPromoter so only accepted, evidenced, conflict-checked work can emit a pending proposal. The promoter cannot adopt, overwrite, forget, merge, or directly update canonical memory.
- **`PR5-C08`** — Compute inference work uses the same lease, fence, heartbeat, retry, reconcile, project-scope, and result-receipt semantics as Agent work while remaining a distinct operation policy and adapter class; compute identities cannot enter Agent collaboration authority.
- **`PR5-C09`** — Server dispatch records only bounded operation intent, capability requirements, identity expectations, and receipt references. Provider prompts, raw documents, API keys, model responses, and hidden reasoning remain inside the compute-node boundary and are never emitted as collaboration events.
- **`PR5-C10`** — Active inference mode is project-scoped and hot-routable. A mode transition affects new work only, preserves in-flight leases and receipts, and requires identity revalidation before a newly selected compute node may receive work.

### Required evidence

- **`PR5-E01`** — Migration plan/grant binding, backup/integrity/rehearsal, drift/fence, single-writer, phase order, restart, rollback, outbox replay, shadow generation, promotion, Maintenance, retention, and stable refusal evidence in isolated and authorized runtime slices.
- **`PR5-E02`** — Persistent Agent/session/work/lease/event/cursor restart recovery, heartbeat timeout, stale presence, abandoned lease, retention, idempotency, fencing, and reconcile tests.
- **`PR5-E03`** — Authenticated MCP/Hook lifecycle E2E covering session-init, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, SessionEnd, sp-stage, step-closure, cursor resume, shadow-to-inject gate, scope enforcement, event emission, and lease release.
- **`PR5-E04`** — Promotion tests proving accepted-result-to-pending-proposal, conflict blocking, independent reviewer authority, and non-promotion of progress, assumptions, peer agreement, semantic capture, self-acceptance, or raw prompts.
- **`PR5-E05`** — Frontend smoke evidence for Agent topology, work board, and event timeline with bounded role-aware data, project isolation, cursor refresh, empty/error/stale states, and no canonical mutation controls.
- **`PR5-E06`** — Independent Standards, Spec, and DeepSec Shield/code-smell review receipts bound to the same immutable source revision, diff digest, requirement set, and union-contract revision, with DeepSec least-privilege and non-canonical-finding proof.
- **`PR5-E07`** — Endpoint-role and import/runtime denial evidence proves server cannot construct direct cloud, Ollama, Jina, SiliconFlow, or structured-JSON provider paths, while compute-node can expose only its declared local/cloud/hybrid capabilities through the private transport.
- **`PR5-E08`** — Routing evidence covers local, cloud, and hybrid control revisions, hot-switch behavior without MCP restart, exact capability/model identity matching, compute-only credential projection, atomic profile activation, and identity revalidation receipts with no secret leakage.
- **`PR5-E09`** — Degradation and recovery evidence proves no-node or identity-mismatch behavior is stable and operation-specific: embedding/structured JSON defer into retry/reconcile, rerank preserves original order, and no server-side provider fallback or context execution occurs.

### Completion rule

- `operator`: `all`
- `required_groups`: `delivery_scope`, `collaboration_scope`, `required_evidence`
- `prohibits_partial_completion`: `true`
- PR5 is complete only when migration operations and the full persistent collaboration lifecycle are wired, recoverable, observable, and governed. A source journal, Hook contract, or frontend mock alone is insufficient.

## PR6 — Release readiness and role-capability contracts

**Objective:** Make the three-endpoint system installable, upgradeable, auditable, and releasable while proving the final collaboration authority boundaries and cross-Agent behavior.

- **Depends on:** `PR5`
- **Required gates:** `U6-GATE-SOURCE-01`, `U6-GATE-REVISION-01`, `U6-GATE-DOCUMENT-01`, `U6-GATE-ASSET-01`, `U6-GATE-REVIEW-01`, `U6-GATE-DEEPSEC-01`, `U6-GATE-COMPOSER-01`, `U6-GATE-EVIDENCE-01`

### Delivery scope

- **`PR6-D01`** — Provide cross-platform macOS, Linux, and Windows/WSL2 installer entry points with selectable local-all-in-one, local-cloud, and split-accelerated profiles, module size/resource estimates, safe-space refusal, basic/recommended configurations, and reversible hot switching.
- **`PR6-D02`** — Build an RC/release bundle that binds source revision, Python artifacts, Model Catalog identity, OCI digests, SBOM, provenance, profile/variant compatibility, installer assets, documentation parity, and immutable rollback references.
- **`PR6-D03`** — Use Windows/WSL2 only for local build/cache/GPU smoke and derived inference; protected GitHub workflow creates immutable release evidence; server pulls and runs only verified digests. Stable PyPI, GHCR, GitHub Release, release-repository sync, and production rollout require separate explicit authorization.
- **`PR6-D04`** — Verify upgrade, rollback, restart recovery, old-client compatibility, single-writer preservation, rebuildable LanceDB, five-day backup retention, daily cache cleanup, and timezone-aware UTC behavior without changing host timezones.

### Collaboration scope

- **`PR6-C01`** — Declare and verify OCI role labels for agent-registry-authority, work-board-authority, canonical-memory-authority, collaboration-event-writer, bounded-awareness-display, bounded-event-submission, compute-execution, and local-edge.
- **`PR6-C02`** — Prove server is the only registry/work-board/event/promotion/canonical authority; edge can display bounded projections and submit typed bounded events but cannot read raw history or mutate canonical state; compute has no developer-Agent collaboration package, tools, or authority.
- **`PR6-C03`** — Run the final cross-Agent E2E: authenticated join, scoped claim, lease/fence heartbeat, peer delta, conflict/review, independent accepted receipt, pending proposal, governed adoption or rejection, restart/cursor recovery, stale cleanup, and rollback.
- **`PR6-C04`** — Include Workflow Composer as shadow-only behavior with frozen plan_revision and plan_digest, compiler_revision, mandatory_hard_gate_set_digest, atomic-skill receipt chain, tool_policy_digest, bounded Agent tools, observable candidate-versus-fixed-route comparison, and deterministic rollback to the fixed route. It has no execution or authorization authority.

### Required evidence

- **`PR6-E01`** — Cross-platform installer/profile matrix, resource and disk preflight, hot-switch/upgrade/rollback, model-identity compatibility, and old-client compatibility receipts.
- **`PR6-E02`** — Immutable RC bundle verification covering source, packages, OCI digests, SBOM, provenance, Model Catalog, role labels, final rootfs, documentation parity, signatures/attestations when claimed, and rollback references.
- **`PR6-E03`** — Role-capability negative matrix proving edge and compute cannot gain server authority, compute contains no collaboration surface, and no unreviewed claim, manifest, capability, project_id, or model identity grants privilege.
- **`PR6-E04`** — Complete cross-profile and cross-Agent acceptance receipt, including negative proof that peer progress never becomes canonical memory, restart/cursor recovery, Maintenance cleanup, migration rollback, and derived-index rebuild.
- **`PR6-E05`** — Mandatory Workflow Composer included-shadow adversarial evidence proves exact plan/compiler/hard-gate/tool-policy binding and rejects stale completion, executing-revision mutation, user-only self-attestation, tool escalation, gate removal or reordering, receipt-chain gaps, source or contract mismatch, execution authority, and fixed-route rollback failure.
- **`PR6-E06`** — Separate explicit authorization receipts for RC creation, internal deployment, production migration, public PyPI/GHCR/GitHub Release, stable publication, and release-repository synchronization; one authorization never implies another.
- **`PR6-E07`** — Independent Standards, Spec, and DeepSec Shield/code-smell review receipts bound to the same immutable source revision, diff digest, requirement set, and union-contract revision, with DeepSec least-privilege and non-canonical-finding proof.

### Completion rule

- `operator`: `all`
- `required_groups`: `delivery_scope`, `collaboration_scope`, `required_evidence`
- `prohibits_partial_completion`: `true`
- PR6 is complete only when install/release readiness and final role/cross-Agent acceptance are both evidenced. An RC contract, artifact bundle, or role label without runtime E2E is insufficient, and stable publication remains separately authorized.
